Commentary.Commentary: We still have more than two sessions left and Pakistan are still favorites. They will also back themselves to chase this target down. However, it will be interesting to see their approach as they also have to keep the weather forecast in mind. The Irish bowlers on the flip side, will have to bowl their hearts out if they are to create history here today. Pakistan do have a reputation of collapsing in the second innings. Will we see another today or will their batsmen come to the fore? Join us for the chase to find out.

Ireland though will be extremely pleased with their effort. They started off their innings with a deficit of 180 runs and they required a good start from their openers and they got it. 69 runs were added by the pair of Joyce and Porterfield before the former was run out. Then a couple of quick wickets in between gave the impression that Pakistan would run away with the game. But then came in Kevin O'Brien and he along with Thompson first and then with Kane added two crucial stands which has given his bowlers a total which they can surely think of defending.

So Pakistan have made quick work of the last three wickets and now have to chase down 160, which I must tell you will not be easy. Abbas was the tormentor-in-chief as he got the hero of the Irish innings off his very first ball today and he ended up with a fifer. He has been the pick of the bowlers for them and his figures clearly show that.

OUT! That is it! Ireland have been bundled out for 339. And yes, Abbas does get a fifer, ninth wicket in the game for him (110 runs scored off him). This is his second five-wicket haul in Test cricket! Mohammad Abbas was the man for Pakistan today as he nipped out all the remaining three wickets. Coming to the ball - It is a length delivery outside off, nips back ever so slightly but it is good enough to induce an inside edge from Kane who looks to punch off the back foot but doesn't move his feet much. The ball crashes into the stumps and the Pakistan players heave a sigh of relief. The visitors were made to sweat hard for their wickets by Ireland in their second essay with the bat.
Already there are some signs of unevenness! Length ball outside off, shoots through after pitching. Kane goes back to cut that, he misses it and the ball goes underneath the bat.
Murtagh stays back and punches it through the vacant point region. Single taken.
The batsman goes after a wide one and misses.
Risky second run but a poor throw from Shadab allows them to cross over easily! Kane sits back and punches it through the covers. They decide to take the second run and get it eventually.
Good length ball on the stumps, the batsman gets right behind it and blocks.
No luck for Amir, he bowls a delivery which angles in sharply and moves just a wee bit. The Irish man is beaten as he looks to defend that.
Good length ball on off, Kane shoulders arms to it.
Fullish delivery on off, the batsman plays a drive to the cover region.
FOUR! Slammed, Murtagh has cleared his intentions straightaway! He gets another one outside off and bashes it back past the bowler. The fielder at mid off had no chance of stopping that one.
Oh hello! Big swing from Murtagh. Full ball outside off from Abbas and the Irish man swings his bat through the line, but can't connect.
Tim Murtagh is the last man in.

OUT! Dragged on! Ninth wicket down for Ireland, Pakistan just need one more to wrap their innings. Indecision from Rankin led to his downfall. He gets a length delivery closer to the off stump and isn't sure whether to leave or to play at it. Fails to lift his bat up in time and the ball catches the inner half of the bat and crashes into the wickets. Fourth wicket for Abbas, can he get a fifer?

FOUR! Fine wrist work from Rankin earns him a boundary! Ireland lead goes past 150! Welcome runs for Ireland. Fulle length ball on the leg stump line and he gets whipped away to the square leg boundary.
Touch too straight from Abbas, the batsman glances it away to fine leg for a single.
Abbas starts a new over with a fullish ball. Kane square drives it to point.
Bowls a pitched up delivery which gets defended by Rankin.
Slipping it down the leg side, the batsman doesn't need to play at those.

Sloppy from Pakistan! Rankin dabs a full delivery to the cover region and calls for a quick single. The fielder there has a shy at the striker's end but the throw is a little too wide. It beats the fielder backing up and the batsmen get an extra run.
Fuller length ball outside off. The batsman lets it go.
Oh dear! Once again, Amir goes past the outside edge. He pushes it back a little but the swing is still there. Rankin is beaten all ends up as he looks to defend it.
Top nut from Amir, those are the ones that deserves a wicket! Goes wide of the crease and drifts it in. The ball shapes away after kissing the wicket, too good for Rankin. He is beaten neck and crop.
Bowls a fullish delivery outside off, Tyrone Kane doesn't offer a stroke to it.
Much fuller but again wider of the stumps. The batsman sits back and avoids it.
Length delivery on the stumps, Kane blocks it solidly.
Good delivery, needs to bowl consistently in that channel! Keeps it fuller closer to the off stump. Well judged by Kane. He leaves it with utmost ease.
Easy leave for Kane, he gets a delivery outside off and lets it go comfortably.
Serves up a fullish delivery on the stumps, the batsman defends it with the dead bat.
Good length ball outside off, the batsman decides to leave it.
Full pitch delivery, outside off, Rankin slices the drive to point.

Play and a miss! Amir delivers a short of a length ball on off, swings away a little. Rankin goes back to defend that. He plays down the wrong line and the ball whizzes past the outside edge. Nearly another wicket for Pakistan.
Leg bye! Sharp delivery, dipping in at a good pace, Tyrone goes back to flick that, misses it. The ball hits the thigh pad and rolls towards square leg. Results in a leg bye.
That one shoots through and the keeper takes it on the second bounce! Fuller length ball miles outside off and the batsman leaves it. Sarfraz does well to collect it.
Amir bowls from wide of the crease, full outside off, the batsman chops it to cover-point
Slipping down the leg side. Kane closes the face of the bat and works it away to deep square leg. Single taken.
No ball! Beaten! Beauty from Abbas, but he has overstepped and needs to reload! Short of a length ball, straightens a little, the batsman plays down the wrong line and misses it.
Typical Test match bowling from Abbas. Good length ball on the fifth stump channel, the batsman lets it go.
Length ball outside off and Kane decides to leave it.
Down the leg side, Rankin gets a wood on it and glances to fine leg for a run.
Full pitch delivery on the leg stump line, the batsman taps it to mid-wicket.
Boyd Rankin is the next man in.

OUT! Abbas strikes off is first ball today! End of a superb innings from Kevin O'Brien, he is absolutely livid with himself. It is a disappointing end to what has been an excellent knock! A sucker ball from Abbas does the trick, the batsman couldn't resist that one and he goes after the ball. Reaches out for it as he attempts a cover drive. The ball swings away a little and catches the outside edge. Haris at first slip takes a safe catch. Kevin couldn't add a single run to his overnight total today. The lead for Ireland is 141.
Mohammad Abbas to bowl the second over of the day.
Slightly fuller from Amir in the channel outside off, the batsman shoulders arms to it. End of a tidy but a harmless one.
Incoming delivery from Amir, cleverly disguised it. Kane isn't expecting that one. He goes back to flick that one but misses it. The ball pings him on the thigh pad.
Continues to bowl in the same channel and this time he gets no response from the Irish man.
Touch too wide from Amir, the batsman slices it behind point to deep for a brace. They take two more. That's the 50-run partnership between Kane and O'Brien.
On a length outside off stump, Kane covers his stumps and lets it through to the keeper.
Amir starts the day with a short of a length ball, angling in from outside off. The batsman stands tall and defends it down the track.

We are all set for the action to begin. The visiting team is out and the fielders are taking their positions. Kevin O'Brien and Tyron Kane are out as well. The all important morning session is just about to begin.

Hello and a warm welcome to our coverage to the final day of the Test. The game is quite nicely poised with all three results still a possibility at this stage and the Irish fans should thank Kevin O'Brien for that. He walked out to bat when his team was in all sorts of trouble. The southpaw registered a maiden test Ton for Ireland and bailed them out. He was well supported by Stuart Thompson and the Tyrone Kane. Pakistan need to strike quickly before they end up conceding too many which they might fail to chase down in the final innings of the game. We are heading towards an exciting finish but the only thing that stands in our way is the weather. The forecast is for some rain later in the day, let's hope we get a full day's play without any interruptions. For the moment, it is bright and sunny at Malahide. Stay tuned for all the action.
... Day 5, Session 1 ...

Smiles were back in the Pakistan dressing room but it didn't last for long as Tyrone Kane then walked in and offered some more resistance with Kevin. They added another crucial 48 runs and swelled the lead to 139. Mind you, they aren't done yet. With the way they are batting, it doesn't seem like they would give it away easily. How many more will they add? Will Pakistan be able to dismiss them early tomorrow? The forecast for Day 5 isn't a good one as heavy rains are predicted but let's hope nothing as such happens and we get to witness an epic end to this historic Test match. Hope to have you on board at 1100 Local (1000 GMT) for the final day's play. Till then, adios. Cheers!

It seemed like Ireland would suffer an innings defeat, but Kevin O'Brien along with Stuart Thompson put all those thoughts to rest as the duo came to the fore and kept Pakistan at bay. They showed immense grit and determination and in the process both scored their respective fifties to take their side into the lead. It required something special to break their association and Shadab Khan produced a ripper to put an end to the 114-run stand.

All the Pakistan players walk towards the centurion O'Brien to congratulate him, lovely gesture shown by the visiting team. A fascinating day of Test cricket comes to an end. Kevin O'Brien, take a bow. He's led the fightback with an absolute gem of an innings to turn this Test around. Who would have thought that when Pakistan enforced the follow-on? Certainly not us. Day 4 began with Faheem Ashraf's brilliance as he ran Ed Joyce out early to give Pakistan their first breakthrough. Mohammad Amir then bowled a deadly spell to push Ireland further on the back foot.

Almost a wicket off the last ball! How has that missed the off pole? On a length outside off, this one stays low and also jags back in. Kevin tries to defend but the ball goes underneath the bat and close past the off pole. Ahmed takes it on the bounce behind. STUMPS ON DAY 4, IRELAND AHEAD BY 139!
Good length on off, kept out.

A huge appeal but an inside edge saves Kevin. That is the only thing that could have saved him there. On a length around middle, this one keeps low. Kevin tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Almost! This is on a length around off, the batsman tries to defend but the ball hits the bottom edge and is almost rolling back onto the stumps but Kevin kicks it away.
Good length on off, kept out.
Outside off, the batsman need not play at those.
Mohammad Abbas is back on.
Outside off, left alone.
Angles it into the batsman and the gets it to leave him. Kane tries to defend but gets beaten. How many times have we seen that today?
The short of a length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side. The batsmen have run through for a single.

FOUR! Edge and through the vacant second slip area! This is on a length and around off, Kevin lunges and tries to keep it out but the ball takes the outside edge and goes through the vacant second slip area for a boundary.
The batsman gets a bottom edge which goes to the keeper on the bounce.
Good length and on off, Kevin tries to defend but gets a bottom edge which goes to the keeper.
Lands it on a length from around the wicket. The batsman keeps it out.
Shortish and outside off, it is cut towards point where the fielder makes a good stop.
Goes fuller on off, it is driven back to the bowler.
On middle, it is worked through mid-wicket for a run.
Good length on off, Kevin defends it.
Down the leg side, the batsman lets it be.
Tries to flick the ball on the pads, but misses to get hit on it.
It's been driven superbly through the covers.
Works it with the angle through square leg for a run.
Length ball outside off, Kevin defends it off the bottom half.

DROPPED! A tough chance but Pakistan would have loved it had Shadab taken it! This is full and outside off, Kane goes for a drive away from his body. He hits it uppishly towards point. Shadab there dives to his left, gets two hands to it but can't hang on. The batsmen run a single.
On middle, worked around the corner for a run.
A short ball on middle, the batsman quite easily ducks under it.
Back of a length outside off, it is guided to point.
Full and outside off, it is driven square through the off side for a run.
Full and swinging back in. The batsman tries to drive it through the off side but gets it off the inner half back to the bowler.
Inside edge and FOUR! This is very frustrating for Pakistan! On a length around off, Kevin tries to defend but the ball takes the inside edge and runs down to the fine leg fence.
Goes for an inswinging yorker but the man out there is seeing the ball like a football. He flicks it through mid-wicket and bags a brace.
Play and a miss! Length ball shaping away late. The batsman pokes at it and gets beaten.
Length outside off, the batsman lets it through.
A bouncer on middle, the batsman ducks under it.
Good length on off, kept out.
Fuller in length on middle, driven to mid off.

A huge appeal but turned down! Bowled on a length around off, it jags back in. Kevin hops and tries to tuck it on the leg side but misses to get hit on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire says it is too high. The ball rolls onto the leg side and the batsmen run a leg bye.
A poor ball to end the over! Down the leg side. The batsman lets it be.
Back of a length on off, kept out.
Bowled on the pads, Kane misses the flick to get hit on it.
Another short ball and the batsman once again evades it.
A short ball outside off, the batsman ducks under it.
Back of a length on middle, it is worked down to fine leg for a run.
Rahat Ali is back on.
Tyrone comes forward and drives it to the fielder at mid off.

Loud appeal for a caught behind! Very full outside off, Kane looks to jam it out but fails to do so. Amir keeps appealing as Ahmed takes it behind but it's turned down by the umpire. The sound was of the bat hitting the ground.
Fullish on off, driven towards cover.
Comes from around the wicket and angles in a length delivery on off, Kane looks to drive but the ball cuts back in, beats the inside edge and goes to Ahmed behind.
Back of a length outside off, Kane taps it towards cover.
Fuller outside off, left alone.
Again full on off, it is eased to mid off.
Fuller in length on off, it is driven back to the bowler.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR LEG BYES! This is poor bowling! Down the leg side again, Kevin misses the flick. The ball brushes the pads and goes down to fine leg for a boundary.
A yorker on middle, Kevin jams it out.
On a length around off, this one rises after pitching. Kevin does well to defend it onto the ground.
Outside off, left alone.
Kevin pulls it through mid-wicket and takes one.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

There it is! Kevin O'Brien, what a knock! Century in Ireland's first ever Test game. His name will be written in history, deserves every bit of it! Well played. Doesn't get to the milestone as he would have liked but he'll take that. Good length delivery on middle, looks to tuck that one away but it goes off the leading edge over point for a double. Removes the helmet and lets out a huge roar in delight. The Irish crowd is up on its feet to laud the effort of their star batsman!
Nervous! Good length ball, slanting away, O'Brien has a push at it away from the body but luckily for him the ball doesn't take the outside edge.
Back of a length delivery, angling across, pushed off the back foot towards point.
Hangs back to a back of a length delivery and stabs it out towards cover.
Another one on a fuller length outside off, left alone with ease.
Plants his front foot across and then shoulders his arms to make a leave.
Lunges forward to a full delivery and taps it towards cover. Wants a single but won't get it.
Good length delivery, angling in on middle, Kane defends it off the front foot.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Kevin O'Brien runs it down to third man. On 99 now!
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery. The fielding side are asking the question. The Umpire isn't interested in the appeal.
Driven through the covers by the batsman.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball - but fails.
Loopy ball driven through covers for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

FOUR LEG BYES! The crowd goes up thinking Kevin has got to his ton but the umpire ruins all the fun by signaling it as leg byes. This is on the pads, Kevin misses the flick, the ball brushes the pads and goes down to the fine leg fence.
Down the leg side, the batsman tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. It rolls down to fine leg and the batsmen run a leg bye.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Nicely bowled! On a length and angling into the batsman. It leaves him after pitching. The batsman has a poke at it but misses.
Good length on off, it shapes back. Kevin tries to defend but it goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket for a run.
Faheem Ashraf is brought back into the attack.
Pushes the ball on off, to covers.
Again on the shorter side, the batsman works it to mid-wicket.
Shorter in length on middle, it is pushed down to long on for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Sloppy effort in the field sees Kevin go upto 95. Down the leg side, Kevin sweeps it towards short fine leg. The fielder there misfields and the ball races to the fence.
The leg spinner from outside leg. The batsman defends it.
FOUR! SHOT! Any top order batsman will be proud of that one. On a length around off, Kane leans into it and drives it on the up and through the covers for a boundary. The lead now touches 100!
Down the leg side, the batsman fails to flick. The ball brushes the pads and goes into the mitts of the keeper.
Wide outside off, left alone.
The away swinger now and the batsman leaves it.

Howzzzat? The answer to that question is not out! An inswinger from outside off. It comes back in late. The batsman cannot react in time and hence does not play a shot. The ball hits him high on the pads. The player appeals but the umpire shakes his head.
A bumper on middle, the batsman ducks under it.
Flatter and on middle, Kane works it around the corner for a run.
The googly on middle, the batsman defends it onto the ground.
Floats it up on off, the batsman tries to defend but gets an outside edge to point.
Flatter on off, blocked.
A low full toss on leg stump, it is driven back to the bowler.
Flatter on the pads, Kevin works it through square leg for a run.
Tyrone comes half-forward and drives it to the man at mid off.
Short of a good length outside off, holding its line, Kane has got nothing to do with that one.
Fuller delivery, angling in on middle, O'Brien gets across and works it off the inner half towards mid on for a single and moves into the 90s with that.
Play and a miss! Good length ball outside off, Kevin looks to drive it through the line but gets beaten.
Short of a length outside off, O'Brien stays back and dabs it to the fielder at gully.
Touch fuller in length, served outside off, Kevin drives it to the man at mid off.
Floats it up on middle, it is defended.
Another googly and once again the batsman is hit on the pads as he tries to defend. The players make a huge appeal but once again the umpire shakes his head. Height may have been the issue.
The googly again on off, it is kept out.
The leg spinner on off, it is blocked off the back foot.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
The googly on off, the batsman lunges forward to defend but misses to get hit on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire stays put. Impact was outside off.
The batsman plays the square cut. One run added to the total.
The indipper from outside off, Kane tries to drive but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Fuller and on middle, the batsman strokes it to mid on.
Good length again but a little outside off, the batsman makes a leave.
On a length around middle, Kane defends it off the back foot.
Good length on middle, the batsman pushes it to mid on and gets a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
The googly outside off, Kane makes a leave.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Loopy ball on off, Kane defends it solidly.
Tyrone Kane steps in next to bat.

OUT! TIMBER! Shadab Khan strikes and finally, finally Pakistan get the wicket that they were desperately waiting all afternoon. A ripper to get rid of Thompson. Khan needed to bowl something special to break the 114-run stand and he does bowl one. Flatter and outside off, it pitches in the rough and turns back in a mile. Thompson goes back and tries to keep it out but the ball skids through and hits the stumps. Shadab is pumped and that ends a fighting knock by Stuart. He walks off to a standing ovation and he deserves every bit of it. Have Pakistan got an opening here? Ireland are effectively 91/7.
Loopy ball on off, it is driven to the man at mid off.
On a length outside off, defended solidly.
On a length around off, the batsman pushes it back to the bowler.
Back of a length on off, it is guided to the mat at gully.
This one goes the other way and beats the outside edge. On a length around off, this shapes away. Kevin has a feel for it but misses.

Cut him into two there! Brilliant delivery, no luck for the bowler there. This lands on a length and comes back sharply. Kevin tries to defend but the ball goes between bat and pad and over the middle pole.
Good length on off, it is pushed to the man at covers.
The googly outside off, Thompson tries to defend but is beaten by the away turn.
Good effort in the deep! Goes for the sweep, connects well and the ball goes towards deep square leg. The fielder there runs to his left and saves three for his side with a dive.
From around the wicket bowls the leggie on middle, Kevin defends it.
This was pure class! Leans forward and strokes it with the turn, through covers for a brace.
FOUR! STREAKY! He moves into the 80s! Shadab floats it up on off, Kevin tries to drive but it takes the outside edge and goes through short third man for a boundary.
The googly on off, Kevin keeps it out off the front foot.
Another length ball which is blocked quite easily.
Good length on off, kept out.
Fuller and on middle, it is driven back to the bowler.
Uppish but in the gap! On a length around off, Kevin tries to drive it on the up. It goes uppishly through gully for a run.
Good length on off, kept out.
Starts off with a peach! On a length and angling into the batsman. It bounces and then straightens. The batsman goes for a drive but gets beaten.
Mohammad Abbas comes on to bowl now. Can he provide the breakthrough?
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Kevin is really picking him well! This is short and outside off, Kevin rocks back and cuts it through point for a run.
The googly stays a touch low. Kevin works it to the man at mid-wicket.
A full toss on off, it is driven towards mid off for a single.
Flighted ball on off, it is defended off the front foot.
Loopy ball on off, it is driven to covers.
Shorter in length on middle, it is tucked around the corner for another run.
On the pads, Kevin tries to work it but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls on the leg side and the batsmen run a leg bye.
Back of a length on off, it is defended onto the ground.
Another run! The two are doing it with ease. This is down the leg side, the batsman works it to fine leg for a run.
Back of a length on off, Thompson defends it onto the ground.

FOUR! Crunched! Fifty up in style for Thompson! Also the hundred-run stand is raised between the two. These two have done a superb job and are literally playing the innings to remember. The crowd is up on its feet to applaud this effort. A short ball on middle, Thompson rocks back and pulls it with disdain through mid-wicket for a boundary.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Gives it air again on off, the batsman lunges and keeps it out.
Flighted ball outside off, it is left alone.
Loopy ball on off, Kevin defends it solidly.
Tosses it up on off, Kevin defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! Too easy for Kevin. Down the leg side, he tickles it around the corner and the ball races away to the fence. He moves onto 79.
Ends the over with a bumper, Thompson ducks under it calmly.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Stuart slaps hard but Shafiq at gully makes a lovely stop diving to his left.
Fuller on middle, a mistimed drive to mid on.
Tucks this back of a length delivery through backward square leg to raise the 250 up for Ireland. The crowd erupts as well and the stand is now worth 93 between the two.
On the fourth stump channel, Kevin O'Brien shoulders his arms.
Angling away towards off, easily left alone.
Spinning in from the rough outside off, ST takes a good stride forward to defend but misses and is hit on the pads.
Floats it up outside off, blocked watchfully.
Goes around the wicket to the southpaw, tossed up outside off, Thompson presses forward in defense.
Drops it short outside off, slapped to sweeper cover for a single.
Googly outside off, Kevin has all the time in the world to go back and punch it back to Khan.
Loopy leg break around middle, Kevin punches it back to the bowler.
Change in bowling as Shadab Khan is called back into the attack.
Harmless delivery outside off, ignored by Thompson.
Keeps it on the stumps, ST gets right behind the line and defends it back to the bowler.
Lands it on a length outside off, nothing doing says, Thompson.
Takes a stride ahead and eases it to the man at mid off.
Outside off, Thompson has got nothing to do with that one.
Fuller and on the leg stump, clipped down to fine leg for a single.

Another beauty from Thompson! Ahead of a length, curling back in sharply, Stuart has a poke inside the line but the ball whizzes just past the outside edge this time. Ireland are having luck on their side.
On middle and leg, wristed away towards square leg.
Good length delivery, angling in on middle, Stuart looks to flick it away but gets hit on the pads.

How did that miss the off stump? Amir can't believe it, nor can we! Fuller in length and nipping back in from outside off, Thompson sans any feet movement looks to drive it away but the ball keeps coming in and nearly whizzes past the off stick.
Presses across and guides it wide of the gully fielder for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Kevin blocks it off the front foot gently.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Thompson looks to play the cut shot but is beaten all ends up.
Good length ball outside off, punched through cover for a brace.
On a length and this one holds its line, Thompson plays inside the line and gets beaten.
Back of a length outside off, Thompson looks to cut but gets a bottom edge towards point.
Wide! Rahat Ali hits the deck hard, the bumper goes well over Stuart's head and it's rightly called as a wide.
Swinging back in on middle, worked off the pads behind square on the leg side for a single.
Good length delivery on off, pushed into the off side off the back foot.
FOUR! Shot! A bit of width outside off from Amir and Thompson decides to cash in on it. Cuts it behind point and the fielder had third man had no chance to cut that one off.
Marginally fuller outside off, driven towards mid off for nothing.
What a delivery! Comes back in from outside off, Thompson has a push at it but this one kicks off the surface and Stuart is taken aback at it. Has a waft at it only to get beaten.
Pounds in a short one, Thompson is happy to duck under it. The umpire signals one for the over.
Slightly short on middle and leg, tucked towards the leg side for a single.
Thompson gets across and tucks it towards square leg for a single.

Huge, huge shout for an LBW! Rahat Ali hurls it around middle and brings it back in appreciably, Kevin is done in by the in-ward movement as he fails to keep it out and nearly falls over towards the off side. Is rapped on the pads and a loud appeal follows. Umpire Nigel Llong, however, shakes his head saying there was an inside edge there.
On the stumps, clipped through the leg side for a single.
On a length and outside off, Thompson decides to shoulder his arms but the ball takes the bottom part of his bat and rolls towards the man at second slip.
Wide! Digs in a short one on middle, Thompson ducks under it.
Back of a length delivery outside off, dabbed towards the man at point.
Good length ball on middle and leg, tucked through square leg for a single.
Fuller in length and outside off, driven towards mid off.
Thompson stays on the back foot to keep it out.
Stays back and defends it off the back foot.

Four Leg Byes! Coming back in from a length outside off and catches Thompson high on the pads. The ball goes off the pads and evades the dive of Ahmed behind. Another boundary results. Ireland's lead now crosses 50!
Short of a good length outside off, slapped hard but finds the man at cover-point.
Good length delivery outside off, pushed to point.

FOUR! That's a glorious shot! Slightly fuller and served outside off, Stuart Thompson presses ahead and unfurls a cracking drive through extra cover. Made a good sound when the bat connected the ball.
Yorker on the stumps, Kevin does well to bring his bat down at keep it at bay.
Back of a length delivery outside off, nicely dabbed down to third man for an easy single.
Back of a length and shaping away from off, Thompson looks to put bat on ball but misses.

FOUR! Delightful stroke! Ali overpitches it on off, Thompson leans ahead and drives it off the carpet through extra cover. Beats the dive of the fielder there and picks up his third boundary of the innings. Lead swells to 44!

Over backward point! Very full and outside off, Stuart bends his back knee and tries to go hard at it. Gets it off the outer portion of the bat as the ball goes over the leaping backward point fielder for a couple more.

FOUR! Edged but falls short of the second slip fielder! Comes from over the wicket and lands it on a length outside off, it curls away and Thompson has a poke at it. Gets a thick edge which dips just in front of Asad Shafiq at second slip and races behind. Hands on head for Rahat.
Rahat Ali to bowl from the other end.
Another length ball slanting across the batsman. Kevin quite easily defends it onto the ground.
Fuller in length on middle, Thompson goes for the drive but gets it off the inner half through mid-wicket for a run.
Shorter in length outside off, Kevin guides this down to third man for a run.
Length ball angling away from the batsman. Kevin rocks back and defends it onto the ground.
Good length again on the pads, Kevin misses the flick and gets hit on it.
Starts right on the money! On a length and around off, the batsman defends it onto the ground.

The players make their way out for the final session. We have 38 overs left in the day, so we are in for a long session. Mohammad Amir will start the proceedings and he will be bowling to Kevin O'Brien. Here we go...
... Day 4, Session 3 ...

Good fightback from Ireland as they avoid an innings defeat! The session didn't start on a good note for them as Abbas removed Stirling very early. Amir then nipped out Wilson to bag his 100th Test wicket and once again it seemed like Pakistan will make quick work of the lower order. However, Kevin O'Brien showed immense grittiness and determination to grind it out there as he stroked a hard fought fifty. He has swallowed 120 balls and has got the perfect support from Thompson. The duo has dealt with everything thrown at them and have stitched an unbeaten 55-run stand. The new ball is still just 33 balls old and the Pakistan pacers can still relish it. Will Ireland batters drag this game into day 5? Or the next session will be the last one of the Test? Join us in just a bit to find out...
Good length delivery on middle, Thompson punches it to mid on. TEA ON DAY 4, IRELAND LEAD BY 32!
Abbas fires a fuller delivery outside off, Thompson looks to drive it away but squirts it off the outer half behind point for a brace.
Good length delivery on middle, shown a straight bat.
In the channel outside off, Thompson is happy to make a leave.
Fullish on off, Stuart drives it to the man at off.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Thompson shoulders his arms.

FOUR! Edged and away! Brings up the 50-run stand with that! More frustration for Pakistan! Amir is really fuming. Slants it away on the fourth stump line, Kevin leans across to push it away but gets an outside edge which flies past the diving third slip for a boundary towards third man.
Covers the line and shows a straight bat in defense.
On the pads, worked through the leg side for a single.
Beaten! Angling in at first and then leaving the batsman, Thompson has a poke inside the line and gets beaten.
Outside off, left alone.
Stays back to a length delivery and defends.
Played to the point region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Taps it in front of point for a single.
FOUR! 200 comes up for Ireland with that one! Fuller and on the pads, O'Brien just helps it on its way down to the fine leg fence. Lead now is 23.
On a length and outside off, O'Brien lifts his bat to make a leave.
FOUR! Beautifully done! A bit too straight on the stumps, O'Brien gets across and flicks it neatly through square leg as the ball races away to the fence.
Little bit short on middle, O'Brien tucks it into the leg side.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Serves it further away outside off, it keeps moving away further, Thompson leaves.
Bowls an away swinger, it shapes away, Thompson has a poke at it but gets beaten.
Good length delivery, angling across, defended.
Drops it a touch short on middle and leg, tucked towards square leg for a single.
Comes from over the wicket and gets this to nip back in on middle, O'Brien fails to keep it out and is  hit on the pads. They appeal but it was pitching outside leg.
Mohammad Amir is unleashed into the attack.
Angles it away on a fuller length, ST goes for a booming drive and is beaten all ends up.
Short of a length delivery on middle, Thompson stays back to defend it down.
Leans ahead to a fuller ball and eases it to mid off.
Leg bye! Angles it in on middle, O'Brien misses his attempted flick shot as the ball goes off the pads towards the slip cordon and they cross for a leg bye.
Pakistan have opted for the second new ball.
Covers the line and brings his bat down in time to defend.
Length delivery outside off, Kevin defends it down safely.
Mohammad Abbas is back on.
Goes deep in the crease and blocks it down gently.
Slips in the wrong one this time, Thompson goes back to defend but this one turns the other away. Beaten!

Huge shout for an LBW! Bowls the leg spinner, it turns in and stays a touch low as well. Stuart presses forward and across to defend but misses and wears it on the pads. Seems like there was an inside edge.
Tosses it up outside off, Thompson presses ahead in defense.
On middle and off, blocked.
Tossed up outside off, driven through cover for a single.
The second new ball is available now!
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Fuller in length on off, it is stroked to mid off.
Good length on off, blocked.
Back of a length outside off, it is guided to point.
Was there an edge? NO! On a length around off, it shapes away a touch. Kevin tries to defend but gets beaten.
Back of a length on off, it is defended onto the ground.
Very full on off, it is driven to mid off.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Goes for the sweep but misses to get hit on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head as the impact was outside off.
Flatter on off, defended.
Floats it up on off, it is kept out.
Loopy ball on off, it is driven towards cover where the fielder fumbles but no runs taken.
On the bounce! The short ball almost does the trick as Thompson goes for the pull. He gets a top edge which goes on the bounce to deep square leg for a run.
Works it through the leg side with the angle for a run.
A bumper on middle pulled to deep square leg for a run.
Full outside off, Thompson mistimes his drive to mid on.

Top shot but no runs! The stumps at the other end saves a boundary! Fuller in length on middle, Thompson strokes it straight back pas the bowler but he is unfortunate to hit the stumps at the other end.
Fuller in length on middle, driven to mid on.
A bumper which bounces way above the batsman's head. It is so high that even Sarfraz fails to collect it. He only gets fingertips to it. It goes down to fine leg for a run.

Fifty for Kevin O'Brien and he gets a huge round of applause from the crowd! Becomes the first Irish Test batsman to get to this milestone. Well played! Loopy full toss on the stumps, whipped down to long on for a single.
A loopy full toss, flicked towards short mid-wicket.

That has spun a long way! Tossed up on leg, Kevin leans forward to defend but the ball turns in and sneaks through his bat and pad  and goes into the hands of the first slip fielder. Encouraging signs for Shadab.
The batsman fails to get bat on that one and is hit on the pad.
Turning in from around leg, O'Brien pads it away.
Tossed outside leg, Kevin defends.
Fuller on off, driven towards mid off.
Now punches one through cover for a single.

FOUR! Edged and that's gone through! Ireland ahead by 4 runs now! Short of a length ball outside off, it bounces a touch more. Kevin hangs his bat out to defend but the ball takes the outside edge and flies past the first slip fielder for a boundary. Streaky but it all counts.
Scores are level now! Huge cheer from the crowd. Back of a length delivery outside off, Stuart gets on top of the bounce and slaps it towards sweeper cover for a single.
A wild slash! Good length delivery, slanting away a touch and asking the batter to go after it. Thompson obliges and has a wild slash at it and gets beaten.
Length delivery, coming back in on middle, tucked towards the man at short mid-wicket.
Prods ahead and kills it into the turf. A maiden for Shadab.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flatter one on the stumps, O'Brien defends it off the back foot.
Loops it up on off, Kevin leans ahead, takes it on the full and drives it to mid off.
Some more flight, landed around off, defended down well.
Tossed up outside off, blocked off the front foot.

Fuller delivery outside off, Stuart looks to drive but this one shapes back in late. Takes the inner half and goes towards deep square leg as the batsmen cross for a couple. Ireland trail by just 1 now.
Good length ball on middle and off, kept out off the front foot towards point.
Back of a length on middle, tucked towards the fielder at square leg.
Clips it away through mid-wicket and takes a single.
Nipping back in on middle, Kevin looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. An appeal has been raised but the height was an issue there.
Good length delivery on middle, defended off the front foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flighted ball outside off, blocked.
Tosses it up on off, the southpaw lunges and blocks it out.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Floats it up on off, it turns back in. The batsman defends it onto the ground.
Loopy ball on off, it is driven to covers.
Shadab Khan is back on.
Good length outside off, left alone.
Runs through the off side this time! This is on a length outside off, Thompson strokes it through covers. Due to the slow outfield the batsmen only get three.
FOUR! The deficit is now down to single figures! Amir goes for a yorker but ends up serving a full toss on the pads. Thompson does not miss out as he flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Good length on off, it is driven to mid off.
A bumper on middle, Thompson goes for the pull but misses.
Wide outside off, Kevin drives it uppishly through cover-point for a run.

DROPPED! Sarfraz has dropped another in a similar way to his first drop. On a length around off, it shapes away a touch. The batsman tries to defend but the ball takes the outside edge and goes low to the keeper's left. He dives and gets a hand to it but fails to hang on. Rahat Ali needed that wicket, it would have boosted his confidence.
Good length outside off, it is pushed through covers for a run.
In the air... but safe! Short and on the helmet of the batsman. He goes for the pull, it goes off the gloves and then onto the helmet. Lands safely in the fine leg region for a run.
Good length on the stumps, Thompson defends it onto the ground.
Fullish and on off, it is driven back to the bowler.
A bumper which the batsman ducks under.
Just ahead of a length outside off, it moves away further. Kevin makes a leave.
Fuller and on middle, Thompson drives it to mid on for a quick run.
Full and around off, it is driven through covers for a run.
On the pads, worked down to fine leg for a run.
Length ball outside off, Thompson pushes at it and the ball goes off the outer half through backward point for a run. They trail by only 17 now.
Length and angling into the batsman. It is worked through square leg for a run.
Length outside off, it is guided through point for a run.
Fullish on off, it is stroked to the man at covers.
Back of a length on off, it is guided down to third man for a run. Rahat needs to bowl it a touch fuller. That is where the swing will come into play.
Good length delivery on off, it is defended onto the ground.
Shorter in length and aimed at the body of the batsman. Thompson tucks it to mid-wicket.
Fuller outside off, it is driven uppishly through covers for a run.
BEATEN! This is on a length around off, Thompson plays inside the line and gets beaten.
Stuart Thompson is the new man in.

OUT! 100 Test wickets for Mohammad Amir, a feat that he will cherish for a while! The sucker ball does the trick, full and outside off, Wilson could not stop himself from going after it. He tries to force it through the off side but gets an outside edge towards the first slip fielder. Haris Sohail there takes it with ease. Wilson walks back dejected and Amir gets his third. Once again just when the partnership was starting to build, it has been broken. Pakistan need another four wickets and Ireland need 23 more runs to avoid an innings defeat.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Just ahead of a length on off, it is pushed towards covers. The fielder there fumbles and concedes a run.
Almost! This is on a length outside off, Kevin has a feel for it. A needless shot, luckily for him it goes past the outside edge.
Good length on off, blocked.
Goes fuller this time on off, it comes back in a little. The batsman tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Back of a length outside off, the batsman strokes it off the back foot to deep point for a run.
Shorter in length outside off, it is guided through point for a run.
Short and outside off, the batsman evades it.
Lands it on a length around off, the batsman tries to defend but the ball takes the outside edge and goes down to third man for a run.
Shortish and on off, it is defended off the back foot.
Changes the angle and comes around the wicket. Lands it on a length around off, the batsman leaves it alone.
Wide outside off, left alone.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Back of a length on off, Wilson pushes it to covers.
Length ball outside off, the batsman tries to defend it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Mohammad Amir is back on.
Hurls a fuller ball on the pads, KOB clips it through mid-wicket and picks up a couple of runs.
Short of a length delivery, angling away, dabbed towards gully.
Back of a length delivery on middle, O'Brien stays back and taps it down on the surface.
Once again pounds in a short one on middle and leg, Kevin ducks under it this time.
Digs in a short one, it kicks a bit off the surface, O'Brien still goes for the pull shot but fails to get any wood on it. Sarfraz collects it with a leap and appreciates it.
Waits for the fuller delivery and guides it down to third man for a single.
FOUR! Poor delivery and that brings up the 150 for Ireland! Something to cheer for the crowd! A full toss on the pads and it's put away behind square on the leg side for Kevin O'Brien.
Presses ahead to a fuller delivery and with an open face of the bat he guides it through point for a single.
There is a silly mid off and silly mid on in place now.
Is right behind the line of this one and blocks it out.
Short of a good length delivery served outside off, glided wide of the gully fielder who does well to stop it with a dive to his right.
Marginally fuller on off, pushed towards the fielder at mid off.
Length delivery outside off, holding its line this time, left alone without much fuss.
Fuller delivery on the stumps, pushed back to Rahat Ali.
Goes fuller but this line is a bit wide outside off, it's driven on the up towards mid off.
Slightly short on off, chopped square on the off side for a single.
Continues to pepper with angled away deliveries, Wilson lifts his bat to leave it alone.

Nearly chops it on! Angles it away outside off, Kevin with his feet glued inside the crease has a push at it away from the body. Gets a thick inside edge which evades the leg pole and runs down towards fine leg for a single.
Slanting away from a length outside off, Kevin is happy to shoulder his arms at it.
Rahat Ali comes into the attack now.
On the stumps, Kevin walks across and nudges this inswinging delivery through square leg and will retain strike.
Ahead of a length outside off, O'Brien pushes it with soft hands towards the cover region.
Keeps it very close to the off stump channel, O'Brien offers a solid defense.
Stands back to a back of a length delivery and dabs it with an angled blade to point.
Slightly short outside off, it's punched on the up but straight to the man at short cover.
Nipping in from a length outside off, Kevin fails to counter that and gets hit high on the pads.
Chipped over! Goes back in the crease and chips it over the man at short mid-wicket to scamper back for a double.
Loops it up on off, driven down to long off for one more.
Bowls a leg-spinner, O'Brien comes on the front foot to drive but it spins away and nearly takes the outside edge of his bat.
Tosses it up again outside off, Wilson drives it towards sweeper cover and gets to the other end.
Flighted delivery outside off, O'Brien leans forward and pushes it through cover for a single.
Turning back in from outside off but it's very slow and that is why Kevin is able to defend it off the back foot.
Covers the line on this one and stabs it out towards the off side gently.

FOUR! Edgeddddddddd and away! On a fuller length, closer to the off stump line, Wilson prods forward to defend but the ball  catches the outside edge of his bat and runs through the gap between gully and third slip for a streaky boundary.
On a fuller length, just outside off, Wilson makes an assured leave.
Fuller and curling back in on middle, Wilson gets across and nearly falls over while driving it back to the bowler.
Short of a length delivery on middle, O'Brien pulls it in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Stump-to-stump line, Kevin hangs back in compact defense.
Beaten! Tossed up delivery outside, turning away from off, Gary presses ahead to defend but this one spins past the outside edge of his bat.
Covers the line and defends it back down the track.
Goes around the wicket and floats it up around middle and off, O'Brien pushes it with soft hands towards cover and runs a single.
Goes deep in the crease to this flattish delivery and punches it past cover for a single.
Tossed up around middle and off, driven towards cover for a single.
Flatter and slower through the air outside off, punched back to the bowler.
Touch fuller on off, patted towards Imam-ul-Haq at short cover. An excellent over from Abbas comes to an end.
Goes fuller and angles in in on middle, Gary keeps it out off the front foot.
On a length and outside off, nicely shouldered arms to.
Fuller in length and outside off, Wilson prods ahead and defends.
Another one swinging back in but this time it's on the leg stump. Wilson is late in bringing his bat down as the ball goes off the pads towards fine leg and they cross for two leg byes.
Gary Wilson is the new man in.

OUT! Gone! Mohammad Abbas with a big booming indipper removes Stirling! Beautiful from the pacer and Ireland have now lost half their side. He drops it on a length outside off and this one nips back in sharply off the seam. Stirling lunges ahead to defend it down with his bat and pad close. The ball hits the pad and there's a huge appeal from the bowler. Umpire Nigel Llong is quick to raise his dreaded finger. Paul stands there with a shock look on his face but there is nothing much he can do about it. Replays show his bat got jammed behind the pads. Ireland still 53 runs behind!
Presses ahead and with his bat and pad close together, O'Brien sees out the last ball of the over.
Flattish and around middle, tucked past the man at short leg for a single.
Lands it full on middle, bunted back to Shadab.
Slips in another wrong one, Paul goes down on one knee to play another sweep but misses and is hit on the pads again. Stifled appeal for an LBW!
Gets down and across to play the sweep across the line but misses and wears it on the pads.
Turning back in from around off, but the length is a bit short which allows Kevin to go back and punch it through cover for a single.
Fuller in length and angling back in, Stirling defends it solidly off the front foot.
Good length delivery, drifting in on the pads, O'Brien clips it in the vacant square leg region and runs one.
Nips back in from outside off, comfortably kept out towards cover, off the front foot.
Lazy! On a back of a length, served a wider outside off, Kevin couldn't resist as he goes for a lazy drive away from the body. Beats the outside edge by a whisker.
Angles it in on middle, O'Brien walks across and works it with his bat and pad close together towards mid-wicket. Risky!
Begins from over the wicket, lands it on a length outside off, Kevin meets it with a tight defense.
Mohammad Abbas to bowl from the other end.

Huge shout for an LBW! Turned down. Another wrong one, sliding in, Stirling prods ahead to play for the leggie but this one turns in and hits him on the pads. They appeal but seemed like it was going down leg.
Flatter through the air, skidding a bit, clipped on the bounce to FSL.
Leg-spinner, turning away from off, slapped square on the off side for a single. First run of the session.
Floated delivery around middle, worked towards short leg.
A bit too full on middle, jammed out back to the bowler.
Googly to begin, it's a bit shorter in length, O'Brien punches it back to Khan.

Welcome back for the second session. The conditions continue to remain overcast. Very chilly out there as the players and umpires walk out to the middle. Paul Stirling and Kevin O'Brien will resume their innings and a lot of hope will be pinned on them if Ireland are to make the visitors bat again. Spin to begin and it will be the 19-year old Shadab Khan to roll his arm over. Let's play...
... Day 4, Session 2 ...

An excellent session is what we witnessed but once again it will be Pakistan who will walk back with their heads held high. They removed one of the overnight batsman out early as Ed Joyce was run out due to some brilliance by Faheem Ahsraf. Niall O'Brien and William Porterfield did try and steady the ship but an excellent spell by Mohammad Amir saw him sending both of them back to the hut. Then, it did look like Pakistan would once again run through the batting line-up but Kevin O'Brien and Paul Stirling have done well to ensure there were no further hiccups. The trail still reads 57 and it would require a good effort on the hosts' part to make Pakistan bat again. Will that happen? Only time will tell. Join us for the post-Lunch session in a short while...

Short on middle, Kevin goes for the pull even though there are two men back at deep square leg and fine leg. He controls the shot well and takes a run as it rolls towards fine leg. THAT WILL BE LUNCH ON DAY 4!
Short ball and it is pulled down to fine leg for a run.
Length again on off, Paul defends it off the front foot.
A little too wide outside off, left alone.
Good length on off, Paul keeps it out.
Fullish in length on off, Paul goes for the drive but the ball takes the outside edge and goes towards gully. The fielder there makes a good diving stop.
Gives it air on middle, Kevin defends it onto the ground.
Comes around the wicket and bowls a low full toss on the pads. Kevin flicks it to mid-wicket.
Short and outside off, Kevin cuts it through covers for a brace.
The googly on off, Kevin defends it to silly point.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Floats it up on off, Kevin easily blocks it out.
Good length on off, the batsman tries to defend but it goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket.
Back of a length on off, Stirling keeps it out.
Length around off, blocked.
Fullish on off, it goes off the outer half towards point for a run.
Beauty! On a length outside off, this jags away after pitching. Kevin has a needless poke at the ball but gets beaten.
Fullish on off, Stirling drives it through point for a run.
Short and outside off, Kevin cuts it through point for a brace.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Flighted ball on middle, Kevin goes back to a ball which he should be playing forward to. He tries to keep it out but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Flatter on middle, worked to the man at mid-wicket.
Floats it up on off, it is pushed to covers.
Loopy ball on middle, it is driven back to the bowler.
FOUR! A gift, a full toss on off, Stirling lunges and drives it through covers for a boundary.
Length ball outside off, the batsman lets it be.
Good length on off, blocked.
Fuller on the pads, flicked through square leg for a run.
Good length on off, it is guided to point.
Bowls it wide outside off, Kevin goes after it but misses.

Beautifully bowled! Googly on off, it comes back in. Stirling has no clue where the ball is turning. He tries to keep it out but the ball sneaks through and hits him on the back pad. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Too high, he says.
Flatter and on off, it pushed through covers for a run.
Loopy ball on off, it is defended off the front foot.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
The googly on off, Kevin defends it off the back foot.
A low full toss on leg stump, Kevin drives it to the man at mid on.
Change of ends for Shadab Khan.
Good length again on off, Paul defends it solidly.
Length again around off, Stirling lets it be.
Good length on off, this one jags back in. Stirling tries to block it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Length ball around off, Kevin forces it towards point for a quick run.
FOUR! A little too short by Ashraf, Kevin picks the length early and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary. 72 is now what they need to avoid an innings defeat.
Good length on off, KOB defends it onto the ground.
Faheem Ashraf is back on.
A yorker on off, Stirling jams it out to point.
Back of a length on middle, Stirling defends it onto the ground.
Good length around off, Stirling pushes it to mid off.
On a length around off, Paul blocks it out.
Good length ball outside off, it is defended.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Ireland! Length ball and outside off, Stirling slashes at it  and the ball goes through backward point for a boundary.
FOUR! Knowing the batsman Kevin is, he will play his shots. Floats this up on off, Kevin reaches out for it and strokes it through mid off for a boundary. 100 up for Ireland.
Pushes this one towards covers. Kevin wants a run but is sent back.
A little too full on middle, it is worked towards mid-wicket. The fielder there misfields but does not concede a run as the mid on fielder is there for the back up.
On the pads, Kevin tries to work it through the leg side but misses to get hit on the pads.
Loopy ball on off, defended.
Lovely stuff! Shadab tosses it up on off, it turns ever so slightly. Kevin does not play for the turn and gets beaten on the outside edge. The ball also goes agonizingly past the off pole.
Good length on off, Stirling pushes it towards point. The fielder there makes a half stop. The batsmen think about a run but then opt against it.
Off the mark on the first ball! On middle, Kevin works it through mid-wicket for a run.
Kevin O'Brien comes out to bat next.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! This was always on the cards. Amir beat the outside edge several times and this time he finds the edge. On a length, once again he angles it into the batsman at first and then gets it to leave him. William has to play at it and he tries to keep it out off the front foot. The ball though takes the edge and goes to the left of Sarfraz Ahmed who dives and takes it near the first slip. The set Irish skipper walks back after a gritty knock. Pakistan only six wickets away now.
Another play and miss! This is excellent stuff from Amir. He angles this one into the batsman first and then gets it to leave him. William pokes at it and gets beaten.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Amir has his tail up here! This is bowled on a length around off, it takes off after pitching. Joyce plays inside the line and gets beaten.
Flighted ball on off, it is driven to the man at mid off.
Tucks it with the turn through square leg for a run.
Loopy ball outside off, this one turns back in. William tries to keep it out but gets it off the inner half and onto the pads.
Down the leg side and the batsman lets it be.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Floats it up on off, kept out.
Slants this across the batsman and Stirling makes a leave.
Paul Stirling is the next man in!

OUT! Knocked him over! Once again Amir shatters the stumps. What a delivery! What an effort by this lad, he always looked like he would provide the breakthrough and he has given one. He comes running in and goes wide of the crease. Fires it very full at a good pace, it tails back in late. Niall tries to play across the line but misses the ball completely to see the furniture behind getting shattered. Amir gets his first, he could have had three had it not been for those two dropped catches. He is up and running in his celebration.
Back of a length on off, Niall pushes it to the man at point.
Good length around off, Niall defends it off the toe-end.
Fullish on off, it tails back in. Niall pushes it back to the bowler.
Short and outside off, chopped to the man at point.
Flighted delivery on off, it turns back in. Niall lunges to defend but the ball turns, takes the inner half and goes past the diving short leg fielder for a run.
Floats it up on off, defended off the front foot.
The batsman has played it fine down the leg side.
Quicker on the stumps, Niall works it to the man at mid-wicket.
Flatter and on off, NOB defends it onto the ground.
Loopy ball outside off, Niall works it with the turn towards short leg.
Goes wide of the crease and angles it on off, the batsman defends it off the back foot.
Back of a length around off, this is kept out comfortably.
Down the leg side, the batsman misses the flick to get hit on the pads.
Good length outside off, left alone.
A little too high this time! Second appeal in a row and once again the umpire shakes his head. On a length around off, this once jags back in. WP misses the flick to get hit on the pads.
Another big appeal! The inswinger this time from off, William misses the flick to get hit on the front pad. The players appeal but once again the umpire feels it is missing leg.
Very full on off, Niall jams it out to point.
Flatter and on the shorter side, NOB pushes it back to the bowler.
A huge appeal but not given! Another leg spinner on off, Niall tries to block it but misses to get hit on the pads. Shadab makes a huge appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Missing leg, I feel.
The leg spinner from outside off, O'Brien defends it solidly.
Floats it a little too full, the spin is out of contention. Niall lunges and keeps it out.
Serves a full toss on off, Niall fails to take full toll of it as he drives it to covers.
On the off stump, WP defends it solidly.
On a length around off, it is defended towards covers.
Shortish outside off, it is pushed towards covers for a run.
Length on middle, it is pushed back to the bowler.
Drops it short again, outside off, tapped in front of the point fielder.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Niall stays back and glides it with an open bat face between gully and point for a couple.
Fuller around middle and off, patted into the cover region off the front foot.
Hangs back and keeps it out with a straight bat.
A bit flatter and shorter in length, William goes back and tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Floated ball around middle and off, defended nicely off the front foot.
Gives it nice air, lands it full around middle, Porterfield jams it out to the left of the bowler.
Tosses it up around leg, O'Brien lunges forward and clips it past short leg for a single.
Shadab Khan is into the attack. A slip and a short leg in place.
So after that brilliant over, Amir is limping but he is not walking off the field as of now.
Attacks the stumps this time and Porterfield defends it solidly. A maiden for Amir and a very good one.

Beaten for the third time in the over! Bowls it in the area of apprehension and then gets it leave the batsman. The batsman has to play at it because of the original trajectory but gets beaten by the shape away.
A little too wide outside off, it is left alone.
Angles this into the batsman. WP defends it onto the ground.
BEATEN! Get in another slip Sarfraz! On a length around off, it shapes away a touch. Porterfield is drawn into a stroke but gets beaten.

BEAUTY! As a batsman you can just hope that misses the edge of the bat! Full and on off, it shapes away at the very last moment. Porterfield stays rooted to his crease and tries to keep it out but luckily for him the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
On a length around middle, it is worked towards mid-wicket.

FOUR! Width on offer and the bowler pays the price. Short and outside off, Niall cuts it past the diving fielder at point for a boundary. The Irish batsman won't die wondering here, if there is an opportunity to score they will go after it.
Good length around off, Niall goes at it with hard hands but gets an outside edge and it goes on the bounce to gully.
Goes back to bowling length on off, Niall pushes it to the man at mid off.
Good change in length! Bangs it in short to surprise the batsman. Niall is late in the hook and misses.
Fullish on off, Niall tries to force it through the off side but gets it off the inner half through square leg for a brace.
Wide outside off, left alone.
Shortish in length outside off, Niall hangs his bat out and gets an outside edge down to third man for a run.
Edge but a run! On a length around off, Porterfield plays inside the line and gets an edge down to third man for a run.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
Shortish in length on middle, William works it to mid-wicket.
Good start by him! Showed no signs of being rusty! On a length at a good pace outside off, it carries at a good height to the keeper as the batsman leaves it.
Mohammad Amir was seen warming up and now he is into the attack. He is battling through an injury but has come onto bowl.
On a length around off, pushed to covers.
Good leave! Outside off, it kept coming in with the angle. Niall keeps his eyes on the ball and shoulders his arms to it.
From around the wicket, he angles it on the pads. The batter misses the flick to get hit on it.
Length delivery and outside off, the batsman need not play at those.
Back of a length on off, blocked.
Mohammad Amir is seen warming up...
Fullish on off, Niall keeps it out.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Guides this length ball through point for a run.
FOUR! That's rubbing salt on the wound! Short ball and put away! There was width on offer, O'Brien pounces on it and slaps it through point for a boundary.

A real mix-up but the Irish skipper is safe! Short of a length delivery, angling in, Nail tucks it towards mid-wicket. Porterfield, at the other end is off as he wants a run. Niall though refuses but Porterfield is halfway down the wicket. Rahat charges towards the ball but collides with the batsman. Hasan Ali, the substitute fielder gets to the ball quickly as Porterfield now turns to get back in. Ali fires a throw to Ashraf at the non-striker's end who fails to collect it and WP makes it in with a dive. Had Faheem even collected that and whipped the bails off, Porterfield would have gone for all money. It would have been a big blow for Ireland. Nevertheless, their skipper survives and they can breathe a sigh of relief.
Good length outside off, left alone.
Well bowled and equally well played! On a length around off, this shapes away a touch. Niall plays inside the line and lets it through.
Good length again on off, Porterfield is solid in defense.
Outside off and the batsman makes a leave.
This is nicely timed! Fullish and on off, it is driven through covers and the batsmen run two.

Another risky run! Is this needed by Ireland at the moment? Luckily for Niall the fielder misses his shy and he gets off a pair. Fuller in length on off, O'Brien drives it towards covers. He sets off for a run, the fielder there has a shy at the bowler's end but misses as the keeper-batsman dives to get in. Replays later on show that even the dive would not have saved him, if there was a direct hit.

PEACH! Try playing that, says Ramiz Raja on air! On a length around off, this one straightens a touch and also shoots after pitching. Niall tries to keep it out but is beaten by the extra lift. Lucky he did not get an edge on that.
Good length on off, it is defended solidly.
Goes fuller again on middle, William tries to work it on the leg side but gets a soft leading edge back to the bowler as he closes the face of the bat a little too early.
Back of a length on off, it is defended.
FOUR! Poor line and the bowler pays the price. On the pads, Porterfield flicks it fine on the leg side and the ball races away.
Back of a length on off, the batsman lets it be.
Fullish on off, stroked to mid on.
Down the leg side, WP misses the flick.
Good length on off, blocked. Good second over by Abbas, he was a little too wide outside off in his first. Here he attacked the stumps and has tasted success.
Hits the length hard on off, kept out.
Niall O'Brien is the next man in.

OUT! LBW! Abbas strikes and two quick wickets for Pakistan! It is almost a replica of the way Andy got out in the first innings. He bags a pair on debut and becomes the member of an unwanted list. It is the inswinger which brings about his downfall for the second time. This is full and on the stumps, shapes back in late. Balbirnie goes for a drive down the ground but misses. Gets hit on the front pad and the players appeal. Umpire Nigel Llong straightaway raises his finger. Balbirnie stands there in disbelief but eventually has to walk off. Ireland in trouble now as they still trail by another 111 runs.
Better from him! Attacks the stumps and Balbirnie drives it to mid on.
Wide outside off, the batsman need not play at those. Abbas has been a touch wide today, needs to make the batsman play more.
On a length around off, it is defended off the back foot.
Good length on off, WP defends it to point.
Andy Balbirnie is the new man in.

OUT! Ed Joyce is short! Tremendous piece of fielding by Ashraf. They have got the breakthrough they needed. This is fuller in length on middle, Joyce works it towards mid on and sets off for a quick run. Faheem Ashraf, there gets to the ball quickly and scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end. He had just one stump to aim at and he nails it. The players appeal and the umpire goes upstairs. After several replays the third umpire rules it in the favor of the bowling side. A frustrating end to Joyce's innings. He was looking so good out there. Walks back in frustration and this is surely the last thing they wanted. Nevertheless, a joyful moment for the visitors.
Have Pakistan got their first wicket? There is a direct hit at the non-striker's end and Joyce is the man in question. Pakistan look very confident as it is taken upstairs.
Full again and swinging away. Joyce pushes it to the man at covers.
Very full on off, jammed out to covers.
Goes for the outswinging yorker but it turns out to be a low full toss. Joyce flicks it to the man at mid-wicket.
Swing for Ali! This is on the fuller side outside off, it shapes away and Joyce makes a leave.
Rahat Ali is into the attack.
Another leave! Outside off and it is left alone. A maiden for Abbas but not a threatening one.
On a length around off, the batsman keeps it out.
Outside off again, William has no interest in playing at those.
Perfect line! On off stump and it was on a length. Porterfield gets behind the line of it and defends it.
Good length again but the line is a little outside off, the batsman need not play at those.
Length again outside the off pole. WP lets it be.
Mohammad Abbas will bowl from the other end.

FOUR! A good way for Joyce to begin the innings today! That was right off the middle. Full on off, it is on a drivable length. Joyce leans into it and strokes it through covers and the ball races away. A good start to the day for Ireland.
Fullish on off, Joyce mistimes the drive to mid on.
Back of a length around off, Joyce defends it onto the ground.

First run for today, not in convincing manner though. On a length around off, it slants away from the batsman. William tries to defend but gets an outside edge down towards third man for a run. Good field placement by Sarfraz as he now knows saving runs is also important, he hence has a third man in place.
Goes fuller this time in search of some swing but there ain't any. Porterfield drives it back to the bowler.
Good start by Faheem, he lands it on a length around off. No movement on it this time as it angles away from the batsman. William leaves it.

A cloudy morning welcomes us here in Dublin as the players make their way out to the middle. William Porterfield and Ed Joyce will continue their innings. The former will be on strike and he will face Faheem Ashraf who will start the proceedings today. Here we go...

Pakistan, on the other hand, will try and replicate their performance of the first innings. They will be fresh and rearing to go in as the conditions are pretty overcast which will keep them interested. The availability of Amir is still in doubt as he walked off yesterday due to an injury. Pakistan will surely need his services today. Let's see how the penultimate day pans out. We welcome you for the coverage...

It's Day 4 of the one-off Test between Ireland and Pakistan in Dublin and the visitors are in complete control of it. However, the home side has showed some fight in their second innings. They still trail by another 116 runs but have all their wickets in hand. The pair batting out there will be expected to do keep doing the good work and get them closer to the deficit.
... Day 4, Session 1 ...

The Pakistan bowlers looked a touch tired in the last session. Mohammad Amir was the most impressive at the start and did provide a few chances which were not taken. He however, limped off the field towards the end of the day which is a sign of worry for his side. The rest were a little wayward and hence could not repeat their first innings heroics. Still even they can feel proud with how the things have panned out so far and come out afresh on Monday and get the job done. Will they be able to do so or will the Irish batters put up a fight? Will Pakistan bat again? Will this game go into the final day? Join us at 1100 local time (1000 GMT) to find out on Day 4. Till then goodbye and take care.

So a session which finally belongs to Ireland. They are still quite behind in the game but have showed great fight and character in this third innings. After a dismal batting performance in the first dig, they came out for their second essay trailing by 180 runs as Pakistan enforced the follow-on. The two openers, Ed Joyce and William Porterfield, rode their luck along and have battled it out for 26 overs with sheer grit and determination to see Ireland unscathed. However, their job is only half done but they can head back with a huge breather for the time being.
Joyce negotiates the last ball of the day as he lifts his bat to make a leave. STUMPS ON DAY 3, IRELAND TRAIL BY 116!

Goes fuller and it also tails back in. Porterfield flicks it through mid-wicket. The fielder from mid on gives it a chase and manages to pull it back in time. They look for the third one and take it comfortably in the end.
Good length on off, it is driven to the man at mid off.

A quick single and they have made it! Not sure if all this is needed at the moment. This is tapped towards mid on and the batsmen set off for a run. The fielder gets to the ball quickly and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
This was nicely played! On a length outside off, Joyce this time does not go after it and lets it through to the keeper.
Short and wide outside, Joyce goes for a loose shot away from his body. Ed should remain calm as this is the last over.
Last over of the day coming up. Will Ireland go into Day 4 with 10 wickets in hand?
In the corridor outside off, Porterfield shoulders his arms to it.
Fullish outside off, William takes a stride forward to drive but the bat turns in his hands and he ends up mistiming it.
Length delivery going down leg, Porterfield tries helping it down the leg side but fails to put any bat on it. A good take by Ahmed behind.
Length ball outside off, punched nicely off the back foot towards cover.
Touch short and angling in on middle, defended on the leg side.
Strayed on the pads, tucked off the hips down to fine leg for a single.
Hangs back in defense to keep this back of a length delivery out.
Comes forward to defend but the ball takes the inside edge on the pads.
Angling in on the pads, worked behind square on the leg side for another single.
Fuller on off, Joyce prods ahead and defends it with his bat close to his pad.
Flicks it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Good length delivery outside off, dabbed down to third man for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Closeeeee! This one comes back in sharply from outside off, Porterfield shoulders his arms. This is one wasn't far away from kissing the off pole.
Stump-to-stump line again from Abbas. Porterfield once again covers the line and defends it with the full face of the bat.
Is right behind the line of this one does William and stabs it out towards cover.
In the channel outside off, William lifts his bat to make a leave.
On a length and angling in from around the wicket, kept out towards mid-wicket.
On a length around off, blocked.
Angles it on the pads, Joyce flicks it through mid-wicket and gets a brace.
On a length and around off, it is defended.
Shortish in length on middle, it is tucked towards mid-wicket.
Shortish and on off, it punched to the man at covers.
Tucked around the corner for a run.
Rahat Ali is back on.
The googly on middle, it is flicked against the turn towards mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Gives it air on middle, it is defended onto the ground.
Floats it up on off, it is defended towards covers for a run.
Amir seems to have injured himself and he is walking off the field. Shadab Khan will complete his over.
Wide outside off, left alone.
Mohammad Amir who is back on starts with a length ball around off, it is defended by the batsman.
Beauty to end the over! On a length and around off, it shapes away a touch. William tries to defend it off the front foot but gets beaten.
A bumper outside off, the batsman evades it.
Another ball outside off, William makes a watchful leave.
Length ball again outside off, the batsman shoulders arms to it.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
That has been timed well but straight to the fielder. Full and on off, it is driven to the man at mid off.
Gives this a bit more air, lands it outside off, Ed pushes it to mid off again.
Floated delivery on off driven towards mid off.
A bit of a delay as Ed Joyce has a change of bat...
Takes a little stride ahead and pushes it back to Shadab.
Turning back in from outside off, shown a tight defense.
Tossed up around middle and off, blocked off the front foot.
Tossed up from around the wicket, Porterfield gets across and plays a paddle sweep behind square on the leg side for a single.
Fullish again on off, it is driven to the man at covers.
Fullish and on off, it is driven to covers.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.
On a length around off, it jags back in a touch. The ball takes the inside edge and hits the pads.
Fires it on off, it is kept out.
Good length around off, this one straightens after pitching. The batsman tries to defend but gets beaten.

Played to the point region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single. 50-run stand up between the two, they have had luck on their side but have battled it out well. They need to carry on though.
Shadab is losing it a little here. He serves a full toss on the pads. Joyce goes for a paddle but it goes over the leg slip fielder and down towards fine leg for a brace.
FOUR! A half-tracker, a hit-me delivery outside off. Joyce rocks back and slaps it through covers for a boundary.
Sweeps it fine with the turn through short fine leg for a brace.
Shorter on the pads, tucked around the corner for a run.
Floats it up on the pads, worked to mid on.
