EDGY FOUR! This will be frustrating for Pakistan. On a length and around off, it straightens after pitching. Joyce tries to keep it out but it goes off the edge through short third man for a boundary. This is an excellent start for Ireland.
Fullish and on off, it is kept out.
Another yorker on middle, Joyce digs it out ot mid on.
A yorker on middle, the batsman digs it out.
Down the leg side, the batsman misses the flick and it goes into the hands of the keeper.
On a length around off, kept out.
Flighted ball on off, it is kept out by the batsman.
Porterfield pushes it towards covers and Joyce wants a run but is sent back by his partner.
Fuller on the pads, the batsman goes to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Floats it up on off, it is pushed through covers for a run.
Another huge shout but once again the impact is outside off. Goes down for the sweep but misses to get hit on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head.
Flatter and on the pads, it is tucked neatly around the corner for a run.
Almost chops it on! On a length around off, Joyce tries to defend it away from his body but gets an underedge which lands just ahead of the stumps.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Good length on middle, this one jags back in. Joyce tries to keep it out but gets an inside edge on the pads.
A bouncer, good change in length by the bowler. Joyce evades it.
A little too straight by the bowler. He is clipped down to fine leg for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Floats it up on off, Joyce defends it onto the ground.

Another leg spinner outside off and once again the batsman tries to keep it out but gets beaten to get hit on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Impact once again was outside off.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tucks it to mid-wicket with the turn for a run.
The leg spinner outside off, EJ lunges and tries to defend but the ball beats the inside edge and hits him on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Impact was an issue there.
Tosses it up on middle, it is worked to the man at mid-wicket.
Shadab Khan into the attack.
Outside off, WP lifts his bat to let it be.
Drives it past the bowler and runs one before mid off mops it up.
Presses forward to a fuller delivery and offers a nice solid defense.
Makes him play this time. Bowls it on the stumps, Ed Joyce keeps it out off the front foot as the ball rolls back to the bowler.
Faheem continues to angle it away, that's the third leave in a row by Ed.
Slants this one even wider, nothing doing says, Joyce.
No ball! Well bowled! Ashraf angles it away on off, Ed Joyce lifts his bat to let it be. It wasn't far away from kissing the off pole. He's overstepped so will have to reload.
Another one in the same channel, Porterfield is happy to make another leave.
Harmless delivery outside off, nicely shouldered arms to.
Goes fuller and on the stumps, it's bunted back to Rahat.
Bye! Angling down leg, Ed tries to clip that away but misses. Sarfraz behind the stumps can't stop it despite a dive to his right. They steal a bye.
Hops back in the crease and taps it away towards point.
Appeal for a caught behind! Short of a length delivery outside off, Joyce drops his wrists to make a leave. Wonder why did they even appeal as the ball was far away from the bat.
On a fuller length outside off, it is left alone.
On the shorter side on off, Porterfield tries to pull it but misses to get hit on the pads.
Length on off, William lunges and defends it onto the ground.
FOUR! Porterfield with consecutive boundaries now! Short and outside off, William cuts hard, the ball takes the top edge and goes over the slip cordon for a boundary. Runs coming thick and fast now.
FOUR! Width on offer and Porterfield pounces on it. Short and outside off, William slaps it through covers for a boundary.
Good length outside off, left alone.
Faheem Ashraf is into the attack.
FOUR! Overcompensates this time and bowls it very full outside off. It is driven crisply through covers for back-to-back boundaries.
FOUR! Bad ball and put away! Short and outside off, this is cut through point by Joyce and the ball races away.
Another ball outside off, the batsman need not play at those.
Wide outside off, left alone.
Another yorker on middle, once again the batsman does well to jam it out.
A yorker to start the over. Joyce does well to get his bat down in time and keep it out.
Fuller in length on off, it is driven back to the bowler.
Fullish on off, it is driven to mid off.
Shortish and outside off, Joyce cuts it through point and gets three.
Shortish and on off, it is cut to point.
Back of a length on off, defended.
EDGED BUT SHORT! Length ball again, angling away from the batsman. Joyce tries to defend but it goes off the edge and on the bounce to the second slip fielder.
A bumper to end the over. William ducks under it.
Fuller and outside off, left alone.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Lovely stuff! This is what he needs to bowl. He has been a little too short today. This is on a length around off, it shapes away. William tries to defend but gets beaten.
Short and outside off, William goes for the cut but mistimes it to point.
Rahat Ali who comes into the attack starts off with a short ball down the leg side. Porterfield goes for the pull but misses.
Uses the angle and bowls it outside off, Ed Joyce lets it be.
Down the leg side, the batsman misses the flick.
Length again on middle, blocked.
Fuller on middle, eased to mid on.
FOUR! TOP SHOT! Full and on off, Joyce loves it there. He leans into it and drives it through covers for a boundary.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Fuller and on off, it is driven through covers for a brace.

DROPPED AGAIN! Second drop off Amir's bowling! What more can he do to take a wicket? He is really fuming as he walks back to his run-up area. On a length around off, it shapes away. Once again Porterfield lunges and tries to defend it. The ball takes the edge and goes towards third slip. Azhar there this time fluffs it. Amir could have had both the openers by now. Joyce was dropped by Sarfraz and Ali drops William.
On a length again on off, it shapes away a touch. The batsman has a feel for it and gets beaten.
Wide outside off, the batsman leaves it alone.
Angles this one onto the pads, William works it to the man at mid-wicket.
Goes fuller on middle, it is stroked to mid on.
Comes around the wicket now and bowls it on a length around off. William lunges forward and defends it solidly.
Good shot! On a length around off, this is pushed through covers and the batsmen run two.
Length ball slanting across the batsman. William plays inside the line and lets it through to the keeper.
Length on off, defended.
Three! Full and outside off, it is crisply driven through covers. Once again due to the slow outfield the ball does not race away and the batsmen take three.
Good length around off, kept out.
Fuller in length on middle, it is driven back to the bowler.
Angles it on the pads, Joyce flicks it to the man at square leg.
Down the leg side, the batsman misses the flick and is hit high on the pads.
Just ahead of a length on middle, Joyce defends it onto the ground.
Works it towards mid-wicket with the angle.
The away swinger outside off, Joyce plays inside the line and lets it go to the keeper.
Once again a poor line, way outside off. The batsman shoulders his arms to it.
Another ball outside off, the batsman leaves it.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
The ball on the stumps and William defends it onto the ground.
Wide outside off, the batsman makes another leave.
Wide outside off, the batsman lets it be.
Mohammad Abbas will bowl from the other end.
Back of a length on off, Joyce defends it onto the ground.
BEATEN! Once again the awayswingers causing problems for Joyce. On a length around off, Joyce has a feel for it and gets beaten.
Length around off, Joyce defends it solidly.

DROPPED! Amir is not a happy man and he should be disappointed as Sarfraz should have gobbled that one. On a length around off, it shapes away. Joyce tries to defend it by staying rooted inside his crease but the ball takes the outside edge and goes to the left of Ahmed. He dives and gets a glove to it but can't hang on. A life for Joyce. Can he make them pay?
Brilliant delivery! A yorker on off. Joyce though is upto the mark as he jams it out.
Starts off with a loosener outside off, Joyce lets it be.
